assertions.assertion: The claim is for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient presents with concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
A mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered to capture the frequency and duration of symptomatic events
The claim addresses the PR-204 denial
The denial relates to medical necessity and coverage eligibility under the patient's benefit plan
